comprehensiveness.criterion: Breadth and Depth of A2A Protocol Description

Article 2 provides a similarly robust explanation of MCP, detailing its origins, core components, transport mechanisms (stdio vs HTTP+SSE), and security considerations regarding user consent. Both articles are strong here, but Article 1 integrates MCP more tightly into the comparative narrative with A2A.
